text:
Priya Rao: Hey @finance team — I just submitted an expense for last week's SF client trip but I realized I don't have the Uber receipt for 2025-05-14 (ride to SFO). The corporate card charged properly but Concur requires a receipt. Do you accept a CC statement line instead?
Ethan (Finance): Hi Priya — short answer: yes, we can accept the card statement line + a short note explaining the trip if the merchant receipt is missing. Can you attach a screenshot of the card statement showing the charge, date, amount, and last 4 digits?
Priya Rao: Sure — attaching screenshot now (card-***/1234). I don't want to blur customer names in the statement, will that be a problem?
Ethan (Finance): No problem, redact any PII. We just need: merchant name (Uber), date, amount ($42.75), and last 4 digits. After you upload, I can mark it as approved pending manager sign-off.
Priya Rao: Uploaded: <uber-2025-05-14-1234.png>
Liz Morales: I approve this expense — confirmed client meeting on 5/14. :white_check_mark: Priya, can you add a one-line business purpose to the Concur note?
Priya Rao: Done — added "Client kickoff: Redwood API integration — dinner + ride" to the notes.
Ethan (Finance): Got it. Two quick process notes so it's clear for future: 1) Missing receipt flow: card statement + manager approval + short justification. 2) If vendor posts a void or duplicate charge, ping us immediately so we can dispute with the bank.
Priya Rao: Thanks. Also had a weird one — corporate card was declined at the hotel on checkout (Harbor Inn). I switched to personal card and paid $210. Do I submit as a reimbursement or will finance handle a chargeback for the corp card?
Ethan (Finance): Submit as a reimbursement. Please attach: hotel folio showing room charge, proof of personal payment (receipt or card statement), and explain the decline in the notes. We'll attempt to reconcile the corporation card decline with the issuer but we need the documentation to reimburse you quickly.
Priya Rao: Uploaded: <hotel-folio.pdf> and <personal-cc-visa-3456.png>. Notes say "Corp card declined at checkout, paid with personal card — reimbursement requested."
finance-bot: Expense ticket #EXP-2025-4137 created and assigned to Ethan (Finance). ETA processing: 3 business days.
Ethan (Finance): Thanks, Priya. I'll process the reimbursement once manager approval is on the expense (Liz already approved the Uber). Liz — can you also approve the hotel reimbursement?
Liz Morales: Approved. :+1:
Ethan (Finance): All set. Quick checklist I updated for the team:```
Missing merchant receipt -> attach card stmt + manager approval
Corp card declined -> attach hotel folio + personal payment proof + manager approval
Per diem/meal overages -> require itemized receipts > $75
Expense policy link: https://redwood.example.com/policies/expenses
```
Priya Rao: Super helpful, thanks! One last Q — client reimbursed part of dinner directly to me (cash $20). Should I record it as an expense with negative amount or attach the cash receipt?
Ethan (Finance): Put it on the expense as a line item: Dinner $120, Client reimbursement -$20, Net $100. Attach any proof (cash note or email).
Priya Rao: Done. Thanks everyone! :blush:
Ethan (Finance): Closing thread — reimbursement to Priya will be issued in next payroll run unless you want an ACH sooner (we can expedite if needed).
